requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can create a new hire's onboarding record

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can create a new onboarding record for a named new hire with a start date
The new onboarding record becomes visible to IT, HR and Facilities staff after creation

requirements.statement: A new onboarding record is pre-populated with a standard set of tasks for each department

criteria.must: Creating an onboarding record automatically adds tasks for IT, HR and Facilities without manual entry

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can add, edit or remove individual tasks on a specific new hire's onboarding record

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can add a new task to an existing onboarding record
An HR Coordinator can edit an existing task's details on an onboarding record
An HR Coordinator can remove a task from an onboarding record

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can set a due date on each task

criteria.must: Every task on an onboarding record carries a due date that the HR Coordinator can set or change

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member can see a list of all IT tasks across all new hires

criteria.must: An IT Staff member can view a list of IT tasks spanning every active onboarding record

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member can mark an IT task as in-progress or complete

criteria.must: An IT Staff member can change an IT task's status to in-progress
An IT Staff member can change an IT task's status to complete

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member can see a list of all Facilities tasks across all new hires

criteria.must: A Facilities Staff member can view a list of Facilities tasks spanning every active onboarding record

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member can mark a Facilities task as in-progress or complete

criteria.must: A Facilities Staff member can change a Facilities task's status to in-progress
A Facilities Staff member can change a Facilities task's status to complete

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can see a dashboard listing every active new hire and their onboarding completion status across all three departments

criteria.must: The dashboard lists every active new hire's onboarding record
The dashboard shows each new hire's completion status broken out by IT, HR and Facilities

requirements.statement: A task past its due date and not yet complete is visibly flagged as overdue in the app, with no email or notification sent

criteria.must: A task whose due date has passed and is not complete is visibly flagged as overdue in the app
No email, SMS or push notification is sent for an overdue task

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can mark a new hire's onboarding as complete once every task across all departments is done

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can mark an onboarding record complete once every one of its tasks is complete
An onboarding record with an incomplete task cannot be marked complete

requirements.statement: An Admin can manage the standard task templates (name, department, default due offset) used when a new onboarding record is created

criteria.must: An Admin can create a task template with a name, department and default due offset
An Admin can edit an existing task template
An Admin can remove a task template

requirements.statement: The product supports no email or push notifications of any kind

criteria.must: The application has no configuration or feature for sending email or push notifications

requirements.statement: The product does not support uploading or storing files or documents against a task or onboarding record

criteria.must: No screen or API operation allows uploading a file or document to a task or onboarding record
